---- MODULE ivy_examples_tlb ----
EXTENDS ivy_examples_tlbDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS
USE DEF Boot, MainCheck, MainChoose, MainHandleInterrupt,
        InitiatorDeactivate, InitiatorLockPmap, InitiatorForSend,
        InitiatorCheckCpuPmap, InitiatorLockAction, InitiatorSetActionNeeded,
        InitiatorUnlockAction, InitiatorInterrupt, InitiatorWaitForQuiescence,
        InitiatorUpdateEntry, InitiatorMaybeRefreshOwnTlb, InitiatorUnlockPmap,
        InitiatorReactivate, ResponderCheck, ResponderDeactivate,
        ResponderLockAction, ResponderRefreshTlb, ResponderClearActionNeeded,
        ResponderUnlockAction, ResponderReactivate

AgTypeOK ==
  /\ pc \in [Processor -> STRING]
  /\ userpmap \in [Processor -> PMap]
  /\ writepmap \in [Processor -> PMap]
  /\ actionlock \in [Processor -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ actionneeded \in [Processor -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ active \in [Processor -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ interrupt \in [Processor -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ currentcpu \in [Processor -> Processor]
  /\ plock \in [PMap -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ tlb \in [Processor -> PageEntry]
  /\ pentry \in [PMap -> PageEntry]
  /\ todo \in [Processor -> [Processor -> BOOLEAN]]

AgIsSend(x) ==
  \/ x = InitiatorForSend
  \/ x = InitiatorCheckCpuPmap
  \/ x = InitiatorLockAction
  \/ x = InitiatorSetActionNeeded
  \/ x = InitiatorUnlockAction
  \/ x = InitiatorInterrupt

AgIsPast(x) ==
  \/ x = InitiatorWaitForQuiescence
  \/ x = InitiatorUpdateEntry
  \/ x = InitiatorMaybeRefreshOwnTlb
  \/ x = InitiatorUnlockPmap

AgIsHeld(x) == AgIsSend(x) \/ AgIsPast(x)

AgIsHandling(x) ==
  \/ x = InitiatorCheckCpuPmap
  \/ x = InitiatorLockAction
  \/ x = InitiatorSetActionNeeded
  \/ x = InitiatorUnlockAction
  \/ x = InitiatorInterrupt

AgIsLockPhase(x) ==
  \/ x = InitiatorLockAction
  \/ x = InitiatorSetActionNeeded
  \/ x = InitiatorUnlockAction
  \/ x = InitiatorInterrupt

AgIsSelfAL(x) ==
  \/ x = ResponderRefreshTlb
  \/ x = ResponderClearActionNeeded
  \/ x = ResponderUnlockAction

AgIsInitAL(x) ==
  \/ x = InitiatorSetActionNeeded
  \/ x = InitiatorUnlockAction

AgIsAwake(x) ==
  \/ x = Boot
  \/ x = MainCheck
  \/ x = MainChoose
  \/ x = MainHandleInterrupt
  \/ x = InitiatorDeactivate
  \/ x = ResponderCheck
  \/ x = ResponderDeactivate

AgFresh(p) == tlb[p] = pentry[userpmap[p]]

AgNotif(p) ==
  /\ actionneeded[p]
  /\ \/ interrupt[p]
     \/ pc[p] = ResponderCheck
     \/ pc[p] = ResponderDeactivate
     \/ pc[p] = ResponderLockAction

AgTlbOK(p) ==
  \/ AgFresh(p)
  \/ pc[p] = Boot
  \/ pc[p] = ResponderDeactivate
  \/ pc[p] = ResponderLockAction
  \/ pc[p] = ResponderRefreshTlb
  \/ (actionneeded[p] /\ (pc[p] = ResponderCheck \/ pc[p] = ResponderReactivate))
  \/ (pc[p] = InitiatorMaybeRefreshOwnTlb /\ userpmap[p] = writepmap[p])
  \/ (/\ actionneeded[p]
      /\ interrupt[p]
      /\ pc[p] # MainCheck
      /\ pc[p] # ResponderClearActionNeeded
      /\ pc[p] # ResponderUnlockAction)

AgAwake == \A p \in Processor : AgIsAwake(pc[p]) => active[p]

AgTodoBooted ==
  \A p \in Processor, q \in Processor : todo[p][q] => (pc[q] # Boot /\ q # p)

AgPLockHeld == \A p \in Processor : AgIsHeld(pc[p]) => plock[writepmap[p]]

AgPLockUniq ==
  \A p \in Processor, q \in Processor :
    AgIsHeld(pc[p]) /\ AgIsHeld(pc[q]) /\ writepmap[p] = writepmap[q] => p = q

AgSelfALHeld == \A p \in Processor : AgIsSelfAL(pc[p]) => actionlock[p]

AgInitALHeld ==
  \A p \in Processor : AgIsInitAL(pc[p]) => actionlock[currentcpu[p]]

AgALUniq1 ==
  \A p \in Processor, q \in Processor :
    AgIsSelfAL(pc[p]) /\ AgIsInitAL(pc[q]) => currentcpu[q] # p

AgALUniq2 ==
  \A p \in Processor, q \in Processor :
    AgIsInitAL(pc[p]) /\ AgIsInitAL(pc[q]) /\ currentcpu[p] = currentcpu[q]
      => p = q

AgALOwner ==
  \A c \in Processor :
    actionlock[c] =>
      \/ AgIsSelfAL(pc[c])
      \/ \E q \in Processor : AgIsInitAL(pc[q]) /\ currentcpu[q] = c

AgCpuPmap ==
  \A p \in Processor :
    AgIsLockPhase(pc[p]) => userpmap[currentcpu[p]] = writepmap[p]

AgCpuBooted ==
  \A p \in Processor : AgIsHandling(pc[p]) => pc[currentcpu[p]] # Boot

AgCpuNeeded ==
  \A p \in Processor :
    (pc[p] = InitiatorUnlockAction \/ pc[p] = InitiatorInterrupt)
      => actionneeded[currentcpu[p]]

AgCpuNotSelfAL ==
  \A p \in Processor :
    (AgIsInitAL(pc[p]) \/ pc[p] = InitiatorInterrupt)
      => ~AgIsSelfAL(pc[currentcpu[p]])

AgTodoEmpty ==
  \A p \in Processor :
    (\/ pc[p] = InitiatorUpdateEntry
     \/ pc[p] = InitiatorMaybeRefreshOwnTlb
     \/ pc[p] = InitiatorUnlockPmap)
      => \A c \in Processor : ~todo[p][c]

AgCore ==
  /\ AgTypeOK
  /\ AgAwake
  /\ AgTodoBooted
  /\ AgPLockHeld
  /\ AgPLockUniq
  /\ AgSelfALHeld
  /\ AgInitALHeld
  /\ AgALUniq1
  /\ AgALUniq2
  /\ AgALOwner
  /\ AgCpuPmap
  /\ AgCpuBooted
  /\ AgCpuNeeded
  /\ AgCpuNotSelfAL
  /\ AgTodoEmpty

AgSendInv ==
  \A q \in Processor, p \in Processor :
    AgIsSend(pc[q]) /\ p # q /\ pc[p] # Boot /\ userpmap[p] = writepmap[q]
      => \/ todo[q][p]
         \/ (AgNotif(p) /\ ~AgIsSelfAL(pc[p]))
         \/ (currentcpu[q] = p /\ AgIsHandling(pc[q]))

AgPastInv ==
  \A q \in Processor, p \in Processor :
    AgIsPast(pc[q]) /\ p # q /\ pc[p] # Boot /\ userpmap[p] = writepmap[q]
      => /\ AgNotif(p)
         /\ ~AgIsSelfAL(pc[p])
         /\ (todo[q][p] \/ pc[p] # MainCheck)

AgTlbInv == \A p \in Processor : AgTlbOK(p)

AgNoErr == error = FALSE

AgInv == AgCore /\ AgSendInv /\ AgPastInv /\ AgTlbInv /\ AgNoErr
